title: Unlawful Taking of a Means of Conveyance
grade_or_penalty: Disorderly persons for joyriding; 4th degree if operated in a manner creating risk of injury or damage; 3rd degree if bodily injury or significant damage results
key_points: Taking, operating or exercising control over a vehicle, boat or airplane without the owner's consent, with purpose to withhold it temporarily.
elements: The suspect took, operated or exercised control over a vehicle, boat or airplane
With purpose to withhold it temporarily from the owner
Note any dangerous operation, injury or damage (raises the grade)
